long_biography.plain_text:
Sani Marc began in Victoriaville when René Laroche and Jean-Claude Goudreault created a specialist sanitation company. Pierre Goudreault represents its second generation. He became president in 1997 and turned an established regional family enterprise into a broader Canadian manufacturing and distribution group.

Acquisitions became his main route to expansion. The purchase of Wood Wyant created a wider distribution network, followed by Five-L Equipment, Total Cleaning Supplies, Chatterson, Sutro and several chemical businesses. The 2019 addition of Copak established Sani Marc Europe in France, while Alpine extended the group's commercial cleaning offer in Ontario. Industry association ISSA later recognised Goudreault for more than two decades of leadership and acquisition-led growth.
